newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian military official at Paris embassy dies.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian military official at Paris embassy dies.

text.p: Jordan's state news agency Petra said on Sunday a junior military official serving at its embassy in France had been found dead from a gunshot wound.
It quoted a military source as saying Dhaher Ahmed Ayyed, from the military attache's office at the Paris embassy, "died as a result of being hit by gunfire from his own revolver".
It gave no details but said the military attache had launched an investigation and informed French authorities.
